found.quote: Ensure you have viewed and understood all of the guidance provided for your module or assignment. Check your module handbook / assignment brief, look at lecture slides, or speak to your module leader / lecturer.
found.anchor: Can I use generative AI in my work?

found.quote: Do not overuse or rely fully upon generative AI.
Be aware of bias and discrimination.
You could inadvertently plagiarise or breach the copyright of someone’s work when using generative AI.
found.anchor: Legal, ethical, and data protection considerations

found.quote: Our LibSmart programme consists of standalone sessions that you can sign up to, some of which cover generative AI and related topics.
For more information, including how to reference AI-generated images, see Cite Them Right’s guidance on generative AI using Harvard.
found.anchor: Academic misconduct and referencing generative AI

found.quote: Use it to assist you, but do not present work produced by generative AI as your own.

unsure.quote: There will be times where you will be permitted to use generative AI and others where you are not.
unsure.why: Rules vary by assessment but no explicit decider stated here

unsure.quote: If your work is thought to contain content that you did not create yourself, it can lead to a lengthy investigation and very serious consequences.
unsure.why: Investigation trigger implied; no detection by staff or software stated
